summary: Recent discussions in the Iceberg community have focused on enhancements to the REST specification, including proposals for generic identifiers and passing arbitrary information. Additionally, the community is addressing ongoing issues related to the Iceberg 1.11.0 release and exploring improvements in column updates and constraint support.
highlights: Proposal to add relative paths to v4 spec
Discussion on aggregate column statistics for version 4
Efforts to resolve blockers for Iceberg 1.11.0 release
